sources: PSNProfiles — grades and PSN progress targets
meta.note: Official names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written for this entry in our own words and cites its sources.

note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Every guide is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description; where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of inventing one. Hidden flags follow the official list as frozen on 2026-11-18.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands and 100%, then activities, collectibles and the money clean-up. Keep this guide's checklist ticked as you go so nothing is left to hunt at the end. If the checklist here shows a single trophy left, open its guide and read the stage it belongs to — the roadmap's last unfinished stage is where the platinum is waiting. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story mission of the game. It is unmissable in practice: play through the opening until the mission-complete screen. If you are rushing the story, do not skip the opening beats; the trophy fires on completion. The opening teaches the movement and driving you will use everywhere else, so treat it as a warm-up: learn the controls here and the rest of the story goes faster. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies fire when the chapter's final mission completes, so keep pushing the story markers and finish each mission rather than wandering off mid-chapter. No side content is needed for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. As with the other chapter trophies, it fires at the end of the chapter's last mission, so follow the story markers through the chapter and finish its missions in order. The name is shown here exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. Finish the chapter's missions in story order and the trophy fires at the chapter's end. Use this first playthrough to pick up the mission-specific trophies that share these chapters, so you are not replaying missions later. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full — the last numbered chapter. Finish its missions in order and the trophy fires at the chapter's close, opening the road to the final mission. By now the story-only missables should already be ticked; check the Missables page before the finale. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission, which unlocks after Chapter 4. Before you start it, clear every other story-mission trophy: the finale is the point of no return for the story set, and anything tied to an earlier mission means a replay afterwards. The trophy fires on the mission-complete screen. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. It is a single named mission, so the trophy is tied to that one playthrough — take the mission when it is offered and see it through to the end rather than leaving it for later. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have a setup chain first, so finish the setups the game offers before the heist itself, then play the heist through to its completion screen. No free-roam robbery counts toward it — only this named mission. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it unlocks. Like the other named-mission trophies it fires once, on that mission's completion, so do not rush past it: take it when offered and finish it. The exact mission trigger is not pinned down by the official description, so follow the story markers. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is one named mission, so the trophy is earned in that single playthrough — start it from the story marker when it appears and play it to the end. If a mission can be replayed, a missed first run still costs a replay, so treat it as one-shot. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission's objectives in order and the trophy fires on completion. VCIA also matters for the free-roam 'unscheduled departure' trophy, but that is a separate trophy — this one needs the named mission only. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Take the mission when the story offers it and play it through to the end; the trophy fires on the mission-complete screen. The official description names no location or loadout, so go in with the gear the mission itself hands you. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the gold for finishing everything the game counts: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted challenges. Check the in-game stats page for what is still missing, then work the checklist here stage by stage. This is the last big trophy before the platinum; it cannot be rushed in one sitting. The stats page is the honest judge of this one — if it lists a category under 100%, that category is the next stage to work, not the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. This is a grind best done across the whole playthrough: take jumps whenever you see them and drive fast and close through traffic. The in-game stats page shows your running count; check it before the endgame so you are not grinding 200 stunts after the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them; one try each is enough. Open the activities list in-game and tick them off here as you try them, so you can see which type is still untouched. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, per PSN's tracked count. Work through the range's challenge list one weapon at a time and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold. This is the hardest activity trophy; leave it until you are comfortable with the range's scoring, and do it before the 100% push. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (42 challenges).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations. Visit every drone-race spot, learn the course on a practice run, then race to win — a win at each location is what counts, not just taking part. The official description does not list how many locations there are, so check the in-game race menu and tick each win off here. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida, picking the faster car for each course and learning the corners before pushing for the win. Any race type counts as long as the event itself is different. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge where Cal is your rival, then out-fish him — steady reeling beats frantic mashing when a catch fights. If you lose, the challenge can be tried again, so this one is not missable; keep at it until the win. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, any title. Step up to a machine, play it through to its end screen and the trophy fires. It pairs naturally with the 'try each activity once' trophy: do the arcade visit early so both tick off together. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock across the map as the story advances — take Andy's missions whenever his marker appears and follow the strand to its end. The final mission is one-shot in the strand, so do not leave the strand half-done into the endgame. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. As with the other stranger strands, his missions appear as the story moves on — pick them up when offered and play the strand through. The trophy fires on the final mission's completion, so a strand left unfinished is the thing that holds up the Strangers & Freaks silver. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand to its final mission. Billy's strand is one of the eight the Strangers & Freaks trophy counts, so keep his missions moving whenever his marker shows. The final mission ends the strand — complete it before the 100% push. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them, so find three more strangers with markers around the state. Strands unlock as the story advances; play each one to its final mission. This is the silver that ties the strands together, so track all eight here. Stranger markers appear as you travel, so check the map whenever you enter a new district — a marker you drive past is a strand you will have to come back for. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and play the strand to its end — the trophy fires on that final mission. Randy is one of the five named strangers, and his strand counts toward the eight in Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Follow his marker whenever it appears and play the strand through to its last mission. Like the other stranger finales it is a single mission, so finish it when it is offered rather than parking the strand. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. These spots are scattered around the state — visit each one and complete the meditation there. The official description gives no count, so use the in-game map markers and tick each spot off as you go; a spot left unvisited is easy to miss in the far corners of the map. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunt when it is offered, track the animal it points you to and bring it down — a unique animal is a single named target, not any animal of the species. The official description does not name the animal or the ground, so follow Bret's directions in-game. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close to complete. A set only counts when every card in it is found, so sweep one region at a time and tick the sets off here when they complete. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a pure exploration count: the more of the map you cover, the faster it climbs. Pair it with the full-exploration trophy and the vehicle-discovery count — one long road trip across the state ticks all three upward together. The in-game map is the best tracker for this one: blank areas are unvisited WAiNK It spots waiting to be found, so sweep the edges last. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — the game's challenge list spans driving, shooting, exploration and more. Pick the easy ones first and let the count build as you play; the in-game challenge menu shows what is done and what is left. Fifty is a fraction of the full list, so this pops well before 100%. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Stay together: the trophy needs your partner with you when the heat comes off. Break line of sight, switch cars, and hide until the stars clear — losing a 4-star tail takes patience, so do it in open country where you can vanish. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level — the streak breaks if the heat drops between robberies. Plan a route past three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving: lingering invites the cops to close in, and escaping resets the run. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and the game logs it. Variety is the trick: try every car, bike, boat and truck you pass rather than sticking to one favourite. The count climbs fastest during free-roam exploration, so pair it with the WAiNK It and full-map sweeps. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down five enemies. Set it up: lure a group together, trigger Combat Focus at close range and chain the takedowns before it ends. A crowded firefight is the place to try it — a lone enemy or two will not reach five. Combat Focus recharges between fights, so if the first attempt falls short, pull back, let it refill, and set the group up again rather than forcing it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA by air without a scheduled flight. Grab a plane on the ground and take off, or steal one and go. The airport is watched, so expect heat the moment you move; get airborne fast and the trophy is yours. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke with a tank in it: get into a Rhino tank and make the most of it. Rhinos are military hardware, so look for one at a base or during a mission that hands you one, then drive it around and let the trophy fire. The official description names no exact spot, so take the first Rhino you can reach. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Go in quiet, move fast, take the goods and leave before anyone reacts. If you are spotted, the run is blown: leave, let the heat die, and try again. Stealth gear and a quick exit are worth more than a big haul. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack the vault, get out clean with the cops behind you. Plan the getaway before the robbery, not after — a fast car parked close by matters more than the take. Five escapes is the count, not five attempts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and take the cash — then lose the wanted level that follows. Hit it somewhere with easy escape routes, not in the middle of downtown, and have a getaway car ready before you start. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida — the whole state, not just Vice City. Drive every road, visit every region, and watch the map fill in. The in-game map shows what is still blank; sweep the far edges last, when you have a fast car and nothing else pulling you away. Pair it with the WAiNK It and vehicle counts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida — one per gang, not several from the same crew. Find each gang's turf, hit its operation, and move on to the next gang's. The official description does not name the gangs or their spots, so use the in-game map and gang markers to find each one. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a mission: go to the beachfront, order or find a cocktail, and take it in where the sea is in view. The official description names the beach but no exact bar, so walk the front until the prompt appears. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom, build speed inside or just outside it, and go through the front in one run. The official description names no specific showroom, so use any vehicle showroom you find. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — bowl a full game there. The alley is named in the description, so find it on the map, step up to a lane and play through. This is a one-location trophy: the bowling alley, not just any lane, is what counts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — grow your duo's following or reputation until the trophy fires. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical read is: play the partner content, keep the partnership active and let its popularity build. Check the in-game partner stats to see what is being counted. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choices the story puts in front of you — this trophy fires on a story decision, for better or worse. There is no way to force it early: play the story and take a decision when the game asks you to choose. Which choice it is, the official description does not say, so do not chase it — it comes with the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — something in the game needs a second attempt. The plain read is a retry: fail or repeat an event once, then succeed on the second go. The official description does not say which event, so treat this as one that pops in normal play rather than something to hunt. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange happens — this is the game's 'what just happened' moment, an odd event or easter egg the description will not spoil. It fires when you stumble into it in normal play, so do not grind for it: explore, follow odd prompts, and it will find you. The official description names nothing, and neither do we. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Build speed, line up a group on foot, and swing as you pass. It needs a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun, so pick a bat or similar and find a crowded street. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to your contacts to clean them, and the laundered total climbs toward $250,000. Keep robbing and keep laundering — the count is cumulative, so small jobs add up. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, anything the shops sell. The total is cumulative across every shop, so buy what you actually use and let the spending build up through the game. If you reach the endgame short of the total, a big purchase or two closes the gap. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garages are bought with in-game cash, so save up and purchase them as they appear on the market. Check the property listings to see which garages are still unbought — the last one is usually the most expensive, so keep a cash reserve for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive anyway and the trophy pops on the tenth. The app is named in the description — use it, not a garage. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
